cards.title: Supporting Your Friend Through Pregnancy
cards.body: You don't need to be naturally gifted with babies to be a supportive friend. Every child is different, and you may surprise yourself once you meet this particular baby.

cards.title: Adult Children Moving Back Home
cards.body: When adult graduates return to the family nest due to economic pressures, parents must adjust their approach. The extended holiday phase shifts into a new dynamic requiring patience and boundaries.

cards.title: Parenting and Work-Life Balance
cards.body: Parents often struggle with balancing family responsibilities against personal aspirations like travel or adventure. Leaving young children behind raises important questions about parental commitment and family stability.

cards.title: Twin Development and Estrangement
cards.body: Raising twins requires intentional focus on individual development to prevent future estrangement. Without proper attention to each child's unique needs, twins may grow apart significantly.

cards.title: Understanding Childhood Adversity's Impact
cards.body: Every child reacts differently to harsh conditions and adverse experiences. Understanding these individual differences helps parents support resilience in their children.

cards.title: Employability Skills for Young People
cards.body: Schools are teaching Year 10 pupils essential employability skills like handshakes and eye contact to reduce youth unemployment. These practical lessons prepare teenagers for workplace expectations.
